c.v: Figure 26.4-5 is the structure of a special character AT_CMD.
If the receiver constantly receives AT_CMD_CHAR and the following conditions are met, a UART_AT_CMD_CHAR_DET_INT interrupt is generated.
The specific value of AT_CMD_CHAR can be read from
The interval between the first AT_CMD_CHAR and the last non-AT_CMD_CHAR character is at least
The interval between two AT_CMD_CHAR characters is less than
The number of AT_CMD_CHAR characters is equal to or greater than
The interval between the last AT_CMD_CHAR character and next non-AT_CMD_CHAR character is at least
